Community & entrepreneurship

Quantitative Investment Association

Connecting students, universities, and professionals in quantitative finance.

I founded the Quantitative Investment Association (QIA, 量化投资QIA) during my undergraduate studies. As the largest nonprofit organization in quantitative finance in China, the association grew to more than 1,000 members and over 5,000 followers on its official account, with connections to domestic and international quantitative firms.

Read about QIA on WeChat ↗

What we do

Connect industry and academia

Bring companies and universities together to exchange knowledge and build relationships.

Build a professional community

Provide a networking platform for people working in quantitative finance.

Support students

Help students learn about quantitative finance and explore career opportunities.
